title: Petition By Wife For Judicial Separation On The Grounds Of Her Husbands Adultery
description: A petition by wife for judicial separation on the grounds of her husbands adultery used for matters related to marriage, divorce, custody, maintenance, or domestic relations. Suitable for spouses, parents, family members, or their legal counsel. Key details required: Signatory Name, Field 1 of 0, Field 2 of 0.
description_hi: Petition By Wife For Judicial Separation On The Grounds Of Her Husbands Adultery — विवाह, तलाक, अभिरक्षा, भरण-पोषण, या पारिवारिक संबंधों से संबंधित मामले के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। पति-पत्नी, माता-पिता, परिवार के सदस्य, या उनके कानूनी सलाहकार के लिए उपयुक्त। 3 आवश्यक विवरण भरने होंगे।
